_comment: Word-level German -> English translations for labels shown in the documents collection (region, ancient_place, modern_place, material_label, object_type_label, text_type_label fields of data/documents/metadata.db, sourced from EDH/EDCS/Trismegistos/Papyri.info). Applied case-insensitively on whole-word boundaries by backend.documents.translate_label(); the original metadata.db value is never modified. Counts are DOCUMENT ROWS (not distinct values) in metadata.db where the word appears in one of those six fields, measured 2026-10-08 against the production data/documents/metadata.db (249,610,240 bytes). A handful of place names are legitimately spelled in German (Koeln, Mainz, Wien) because that is the place's own name in the gazetteer's working language, the same way 'Roma' is not translated to 'Rome'; those are left alone. Only connector words, placeholder words and descriptive geographic terms are translated here.
